name: brain
description: Brain: a pattern for distilling Claude Code sessions, and anything you hand the agent, into a private wiki it maintains for you.

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Distill every Claude Code session into a private wiki the agent maintains about you and your work. A session-end hook digests each transcript; /brain:ingest folds them into Markdown pages in a local git repo you own, where your own edits outrank the agent's.
